title: Mice and Mystics
subtitle: A cooperative storybook adventure of miniature rodent heroes saving a fractured kingdom
tagline: Play as heroic mice, brave the castle hazards, and save the afflicted King.
loreSummary: Transformed into mice by the court mystic Maginos to escape the evil sorceress Vanestra, Prince Collin and his loyal companions must scamper through a castle now twenty times larger, dodging scuttling roaches, venomous rats, and the fearsome feline Brodie.
keyFeatures: Charming storybook narrative blending evocative fairy-tale storytelling with tactical miniature play
Creative scale-based equipment like button shields, toothpick spears, and thimble helmets
Dynamic cheese-wheel resource system powering mighty heroic abilities and enemy surges
Family-friendly campaign structure welcoming cooperative adventurers of all experience levels
